params.body:
Removes what nothing calls or reads, and fixes a leak on the box.

**The leak: test databases in `/tmp`**
- On the box, every test run left its temporary databases behind: 4,655 folders (2.2 GB) by 2026-09-29, and more with every deploy.
- Most test files never call `cleanup()`, and the fallback in `db-path.mjs` never removed its own.
- Both now remove themselves on `process.exit`. `bin/auto-deploy` also sweeps what a test process killed by the timeout leaves behind (older than one hour).
- Locally: a full run used to leave about 130 folders; now it leaves only the rare killed process.

**Removed, because nothing calls it** (checked against dashboard, studio and site; see the audit of 2026-09-29)
- **Routes:**
  - `/graph-data`, which served the whole interpretive graph;
  - `/system-map` together with `system-map.mjs` (221 lines);
  - `/source-analytics`, `/apify-usage`, `/explain`, `/phases`, `/drive-ingest`;
  - `/report-audit`, `/quality/stages`, `/quality/chain`, `/quality/recommendations`, `/quality/amplification`.

  `insightSubgraph` stays: the projection uses it for the site.
- **One-off scripts:** `backfill-images`, `canon-sources`, `repair-concept-ids`, `repair-sources`, `topup-evidence`, `bin/rematch-citations`, `bin/seed-reports`.
- **Exports:** `getSnapshots`, `logScoutActions`, `getActiveVariant`, `promoteVariant`, `getCompany`, `REPORT_PENDING_STATUSES`, `REGION_LEAVES`, `CONSOLIDATE_JUDGE_AFTER_DAYS`, `getProveMLInstructions`, `callModelAgent`.
- **`self-improve.mjs`,** 1,191 lines down to about 570:
  - Prompt optimisation ran daily and promoted prompt variants, but nothing read the promoted variant, so it only cost model calls.
  - The benchmark, agent benchmark and debate had never been run.
  - Model experiment, classifier self-correction, trust calibration and graph pruning stay.
- **Tests:** the `/graph-data` gate test goes along (the subgraph tests stay), and `smoke-studio.mjs` no longer checks the removed routes.

**Not touched here, awaiting a decision:** the client functions (companies, projects, pull-insights, chat sessions), `packages/app` (separate PR), `scan_log`.

Checks: 960 tests, 0 failures. A working no-undef lint over `packages`, `bin` and `test` finds 0 undefined names; a probe file with an undefined name is caught.
params.title: Remove what nothing calls or reads; test databases clean up after themselves
